side_missions.title: Salvage Operation Bravo
side_missions.description: The League has identified a pre-war crystal refinery in the Bone Yard — strategic value: immeasurable. Dave is tasked with securing the site and cataloguing its contents before scavengers strip it clean.

objectives.description: Clear a safe approach vector through the debris field
Secure the refinery and neutralise squatter threats
Catalogue all recoverable assets for League use

side_missions.title: Operation Ceasefire
side_missions.description: League command sees the Lion civil war as a destabilising wildcard. Dave is ordered to facilitate ceasefire negotiations — not out of kindness, but because a unified Lion Dominion is a predictable one.

objectives.description: Establish a secure communication channel between Lion factions
Provide military security for the peace negotiations

side_missions.title: Heist Interdiction
side_missions.description: League intelligence has intercepted Goblin Scrapper communications detailing a planned raid on a Lion crystal vault. Dave's orders are clear: stop the heist and arrest the perpetrators. The fact that it might earn Lion goodwill is a bonus.

objectives.description: Set an ambush at the vault perimeter

side_missions.title: Project Antiquity
side_missions.description: Echo, the degrading Bone Yard AI, has offered Dave a deal: Builder-era technology in exchange for a data preservation effort. The League wants the tech. Dave wonders if preserving an ancient mind is worth the risk.

objectives.description: Negotiate terms with Echo for technology access
Disable the Builder automated defense grid
Secure Builder technology for League analysis
